checks.criterion: Login não retorna à tela inicial
checks.name: login-persists-after-navigation-reload
checks.evidence: Logged in with demo.cashcontrol@emergent.dev / CashControl#2026, app-sidebar + account-email visible. page.reload() kept dashboard visible (no login-page). Re-navigating to '/' also kept dashboard visible; login-page never reappeared.

checks.name: session-survives-localstorage-clear
checks.evidence: After demo login, ran window.localStorage.clear() then page.reload(). Dashboard (app-sidebar, account-email) still rendered; login-page did not appear, confirming session relies on the httpOnly cookie, not localStorage.

checks.criterion: Sessão via cookie httpOnly validada por /api/auth/session
checks.name: test_tscheck_auth_session.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/auth/session with no cookie -> 200 null (no 401). POST /api/auth/login with valid creds -> 200 + cashcontrol_session cookie set; GET /api/auth/session -> 200 with matching email. POST /api/auth/logout -> 204; subsequent GET /api/auth/session -> 200 null. 3/3 tests passed.

checks.name: invalid-login-shows-error-no-session
checks.evidence: Submitted demo email with wrong password: login-page stayed visible, auth-error showed non-empty message, app-sidebar never rendered, GET /api/auth/session returned null, and reload kept login-page visible.

checks.criterion: Login inválido rejeitado sem criar sessão (API)
checks.name: test_tscheck_auth_session.py::test_login_invalid_password_rejected_no_session_created
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/login with wrong password for an existing tscheck- user -> 401, no cashcontrol_session cookie set on the client, GET /api/auth/session -> 200 null.

checks.name: logout-ends-session-no-reentry
checks.evidence: Signed up a tscheck- user, logged out via logout-button, login-page reappeared, GET /api/auth/session returned null, and reloading without supplying credentials again kept login-page visible (app-sidebar never rendered).

checks.criterion: Cadastro, login e logout seguros (pré-existente, regressão)
checks.name: signup-login-logout-flow
checks.evidence: Re-ran prior signup/login/logout/re-login browser check; still passes after login-persistence changes.

checks.name: demo-login-dashboard-loads
checks.evidence: Re-ran prior demo-login browser check; dashboard renders with zero non-favicon console errors.

checks.name: persistence-mongodb-reload
checks.evidence: Re-ran by name: unique transaction created, PUT /api/finance synced, localStorage key removed, reload still showed the entry - served from MongoDB via GET /api/finance.

checks.name: authenticated-flows-preserved
checks.evidence: Re-ran; navigation across Dashboard/Lançamentos/Cartões/Visão anual still works post-login-fix, app-main rendered at each stop.
